answer: Per-account upkeep rent: every agent pays a small flat fee each epoch just to stay registered, the way each boat pays the same mooring rent at a wharf whether it hauls a full catch or only a zephyr of cargo. Honest agents earn far more than the rent, but a sybil farm pays it once per fake account, so a thousand shells in one orchard of identities burn a thousand rents every epoch while their thin, split rewards rarely cover the bill.
